name: PitchWall

sources.title: Submit your product — Free vs Pro $49 vs Premium $99 plan table

conditions: Free Launch exists but carries a minimum 30-day waiting period and only 1-day homepage visibility; newsletter mention is 'not guaranteed' on free
All tiers include a DR 70 do-follow backlink and a tweet from Pitchwall's X account
requirements: Product suitable for a launch/feature listing (site claims DR 70, 500k+ monthly visitors, 65,000+ products published since 2015)
Plan selection up front: /product/submit?plan=free | pro | premium
preparation: Plan choice: Free $0 (1-day homepage, ≥30-day wait) / Pro $49 (2-day homepage, 2-week wait, guaranteed newsletter mention) / Premium $99 (2-day homepage, your chosen date or as early as tomorrow)
Launch date preference if paying Premium
workflow: Open /submit, choose a plan (Free / Pro / Premium)
Free: wait ≥30 days; Pro: ~2-week wait; Premium: featured on your chosen date
Product gets its homepage window + do-follow link + tweet; newsletter mention guaranteed on paid only
watchFor: Free tier's newsletter mention is explicitly NOT guaranteed — the guaranteed newsletter slot starts at $49
'Minimum 30-day waiting period' means the free wait can be longer
Traffic stats (500k visitors, 50k newsletter subs) are self-reported on the submit page
Guest post and advertise channels exist as separate paid surfaces
countsAsLive: Product featured on pitchwall.co homepage for its paid/free window with a permanent product page containing the do-follow backlink
unknowns: Whether an account is required before the plan form
How long listings persist after the homepage window
